item.title: Jordan Kahn Music Company - Audio Engineer
item.description:
As an audio engineer for Jordan Kahn Music Company, I am the sole audio providor through setup, soundcheck, front of house mixing, monitor mixing, and tear down. Integrating the company system in any room standalone or with existing audio equipment, I provide music to keep clients dancing all night, from wedding receptions to corporate mixers.

I work with a Midas M32 digital mixer controlled from an iPad, Sennheiser and Shure wireless microphones and wireless IEM transmitters, and a fully miked band, typically consisting of 11 members.

item.title: Castle Rock Music - Guitar Teacher
item.description:
If you’re interested in booking guitar lessons, you can fill out the contact formin the top right corner. You can also find me at Castle Rock Music here, and email me at grady@castlerockmusic.com

As an educator, I strive to meet students where they’re at, whether it’s their first time picking up the instrument or they’re coming to me to get past a progress plateau later in their development. I love and appreciate all genres of music, but most importantly I want music lessons to be the part of your day that you look forward to. There’s no set path, each lesson is tailored to the student’s interests and curiosities

item.title: Macedonia Baptist Church Denver - Audio Engineer
item.description:
If you’re interested in learning more about Macedonia Baptist Church Denver, you can find their website here

As the in house engineer at Macedonia Baptist Church, I work directly with church staff, speakers, band, and choir members to create a seamless interaction with the audio system . I strive for clear speech and engaging music from FOH, an accurate transmission to the weekly livestream, and clean in-ear mixes for the band.
